Pregnant woman dies by suicide after husband demands DNA test

A pregnant woman in Telangana's Medak district died by suicide following alleged harassment by her husband, who reportedly demanded a DNA test for their unborn child. The incident has led to the arrest of the husband and his mother. The victim's mother cited continuous harassment as the cause.
